svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Breast cancer death rate in women
Reported deaths from breast cancer per 100,000 women, based on the underlying cause listed on death

tspan.tspan: To allow for comparisons between countries and over time, this metric is age-standardized. All deaths in a country may not have been

text.tspan: registered with a cause of death. Comparisons may be affected by differences in measurement.
